name: KG embedding diff sync (hourly reconciler)
notes: [Created 2026-06-12, fragility review #4; hourly cadence is a user directive: 'at least the diff every hour'.] Reconciles the chroma label + identity + context collections against sqlite: removes ghost vectors (deleted/merged nodes), embeds missing ones (failed inline embeds, new nodes), re-embeds text drift (rename / identity regen). Local MiniLM = free; no-op when in sync. Drift on the resolution path cannot survive an hour. BOUNDED: max_embeds=1200/run (~480s at ~0.4s/embed) so a large backlog - e.g. the boot self-heal dropping node_context, leaving ~6.6k vectors to rebuild - converges over several runs instead of breaching the watchdog (it did on 2026-06-12: 6062 context embeds in one unbounded run hit the old 600s cap). max_run_seconds 900 leaves margin for the scan + a full budget.
